calibration: Absolute paired median within 2% for ordinary vs frozen, narrow vs exact 946, and direct vs exact 948, on both inputs.
qualification: Faster paired median and at least 9/12 wins vs both frozen and ordinary on both inputs. Joint must also meet the same requirement vs narrow, direct, and exact 946.
phase: Three separate solve, gather and FFT clock blocks per same-build arm. Compare clocked process means to the matching unclocked arms within 3%.
interaction: Within each block compute joint latency minus narrow latency minus direct latency plus ordinary latency. Negative means greater reduction than the sum of the two isolated changes.
correctness: Reverify each export with independent Gnark. Trace direct quartet counts on both inputs in the local preflight and test zero optional capacity and invalid K metadata.
